classificationRationale: An independent reimplementation of the historical FastAPI deterministic hash fallback reproduces every stored historical SBERT-only score exactly (16/16). The current service-derived scores match direct SentenceTransformer all-MiniLM-L6-v2 cosine scores for all six traced cases. Therefore the historical artifact is fallback output, not the intended all-MiniLM-L6-v2 cosine baseline.

hashFallbackReproduction.scoreCalculation: sha256(lowercase text) -> 384 deterministic values -> cosine -> clamp [0,1] -> round to 3 decimals

confirmedUnchanged: sbert-service/app.py is unchanged between e756c2e and current HEAD, including SentenceTransformer loading, deterministic fallback, /embed response shape, and /health behavior.
backend/src/services/sbert.service.js is unchanged between e756c2e and current HEAD, including POST /embed, vector parsing, cosine calculation, clamp to [0,1], and three-decimal rounding.
The evaluation dataset is unchanged between e756c2e and current HEAD.
semanticCodeComparison.currentRunnerDifference: backend/scripts/run-topic-evaluation.js changed production-combined and lexical-fallback scoring after e756c2e, but its SBERT-only path remains submitted.title/existing.title -> calculateSbertSimilarities -> normalizeScore. This cannot explain the stored SBERT-only values.
semanticCodeComparison.historicalFallbackBehavior: The source catches sentence-transformers import/model/encode failures and emits deterministic hash vectors while keeping model set truthy. /health returns status=healthy and MODEL_NAME.split('/')[-1] regardless of fallback mode.

currentServiceFingerprint.actualRuntimeBehavior: CONFIRMED real all-MiniLM-L6-v2 behavior by direct-model score agreement on six raw-title pairs.
currentServiceFingerprint.modelLoadPath: UNKNOWN from the health API and process output; direct execution loaded sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 from the local Hugging Face cache.

environmentControls.model: No model environment variable is read by sbert-service/app.py; MODEL_NAME is hard-coded.
environmentControls.clientTarget: SBERT_SERVICE_URL can select a different service endpoint.
environmentControls.clientTimeout: SBERT_TIMEOUT can affect request failure timing but not successful-score math.

pilotConsequence.rationale: TITLE_ONLY and STRUCTURED_CONTEXT were both scored against the same currently verified real-model service; their relative comparison remains valid as a current-model pilot. It must not use the historical fallback artifact as a semantic baseline or claim final effectiveness.

limitations: Direct verification used currently installed package versions rather than the historical pinned environment, but it exactly matched the live service for every traced case.
The current health endpoint cannot independently disclose fallback/runtime mode; direct model agreement supplies the runtime evidence for the traced pairs.
The pilot dataset remains manually constructed and is not lecturer-reviewed ground truth.
